feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: A breakthrough for the group on the trail of Chinese hackers
entry.summary: Chinese government hackers are secretly burrowing into critical networks using creative new methods.

entry.title: Despite her own hard times, a Maryland woman became a leading data center activist
entry.summary: Despite her hard financial times, a Maryland woman became a leading local data center activist — an example of the way the issue has prompted people to get involved.

entry.title: Meet the creator of 'Spooky Lake Month,' exploring the world's haunted hydrology
entry.summary: Geo Rutherford is a TikTok creator whose annual series "Spooky Lake Month" has amassed her millions of followers.

entry.title: Trump's Department of Justice is wading into elections in unprecedented ways
entry.summary: Under President Trump, the Justice Department has taken numerous steps to wade into elections. This includes new and unprecedented lawsuits filed in California and Alaska.

entry.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
entry.summary: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.

entry.title: Democrats are hoping Latino voters swing back their way in Arizona and elsewhere
entry.summary: This year, Democrats are hoping Latino voters swing back to them. Particularly in Arizona, where the party is trying to flip to some competitive congressional races.

entry.title: New teachers union president wants to steer educators away from partisan politics
entry.summary: The new president of the nation's largest labor union, Princess Moss, talks about the challenges facing educators and the next steps for the National Education Association.

entry.title: With so many data points, this is what to pay attention to before Election Day
entry.summary: With data about early voting, campaign ad spending and polls coming in during the final days of voting, it's important to make sense of what matters in understanding this election.

entry.title: Civil rights leader Dolores Huerta's love of jazz revealed her awe for art
entry.summary: Dolores Huerta was a civil rights icon and labor leader who met countless famous people in her long life. She was also a passionate jazz fan, who found herself speechless when she met Charlie Parker.

entry.title: Most tweens and teens use AI for schoolwork and emotional support, a new survey shows
entry.summary: Four out of five teens are using AI chatbots for schoolwork and emotional support, according to new survey data.
